premises: Group IV additions to bcc HEAs induce dislocation core asymmetry
Dislocation core asymmetry increases available slip planes and enhances dislocation mobility
Enhanced dislocation mobility improves room-temperature ductility
Refractory bcc HEAs (NbTaMo, NbTaMoW, NbTaMoWV) exhibit symmetric cores
The proposed mechanism will preserve high-temperature mechanical performance
